wargear.name: Ferrite plate
wargear.summary: Layered ferro-ceramic slabs grafted over a magos's vitals.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Ferrite plate has a Save Characteristic of 2+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Inversion field
wargear.summary: A salvaged dome-projector that folds incoming energy back on itself.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Inversion field has an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Servo-limb augmentation
wargear.summary: Extra mechadendrites with their own sub-routines for close work.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Servo-limb augmentation adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic.

wargear.name: Targeting coda
wargear.summary: A cortex-uploaded firing script from the Taghmata's best gunnery-priests.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Targeting coda, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

wargear.name: Auto-repair cradle
wargear.summary: A sling of servo-arms and spare plate carried inside the hull.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with an Auto-repair cradle adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic.

wargear.name: Null-lattice cage
wargear.summary: A cogitated cage of ward-glyphs woven round the bearer's cortex.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Null-lattice cage has the Null Lattice Special Rule.

wargear.name: Doctrina uplink
wargear.summary: A mnemonic data-hub that stretches the commander's control over distant automata.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Doctrina uplink has the Wide-Band Command Special Rule.

wargear.name: Covenant cog-banner
wargear.summary: A cog-toothed banner on a servo-arm, signalling the Machine God's will.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Covenant cog-banner, all Models in that Unit have the Rally the Covenant Special Rule.

wargear.name: Strategos engram
wargear.summary: A war-engram slaved to the Praetorian's targeting.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Strategos engram, all Models in that Unit have the Strategos Lock Special Rule.

wargear.name: Gyro-lock pylons
wargear.summary: Stabiliser pylons that keep the guns steady at speed.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Gyro-lock pylons has the Gyro-Lock Special Rule.

wargear.name: Piston-chant grille
wargear.summary: A vox-grille that roars binharic psalms in time with the pistons.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Piston-chant grille has the War-Chant Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hypercog coprocessor
wargear.summary: A parallel logic engine that shortens the response cycle.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Hypercog coprocessor adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic and has the Reflex Subroutine Special Rule.

modifiers.text: Ordo Reductor targeters: +1 BS, -1 Side armour.

rules.name: Cold Calculus
rules.summary: The maniples share a single firing solution.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack against an enemy Unit that another friendly Unit with this Special Rule has already made a Shooting Attack against in the same Phase, all Models in the firing Unit add 1 to their Ballistic Skill Characteristic for that attack.

rules.name: Subtractive Fire
rules.summary: Walls and bunkers are only data waiting to be subtracted.
rules.text: Shooting Attacks made by a Model with this Special Rule ignore the Shrouded (X) Special Rule of their targets, and the target gains no benefit from Cover or from a Fortification Save.

rules.name: Cult Fervour
rules.summary: The cult has long since stopped fearing the flesh.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to its Cool Characteristic when taking a Cool Check. Once per battle, when a Unit with this Special Rule is reduced to half of its starting Models or fewer, all Models in it add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Vigil Protocol
rules.summary: The Thallax take station around their master.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule may make a Set-up Move of up to 6". It cannot end that move within 9" of any enemy Model. A friendly Magos, Archmagos or Tech-Priest within 3" of a Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic.

rules.name: Endless Tithe
rules.summary: The forge-world's billions replace what the war consumes.
rules.text: Once per battle, when the first Unit with this Special Rule is destroyed, the Controlling Player may place it in Reserves at the start of their next Battle Turn with half of its starting Models (rounding up). That Unit has the Outflank Special Rule for that arrival.

rules.name: Null Lattice
rules.summary: A cogitated cage of ward-glyphs woven round the bearer's cortex.
rules.text: A Psychic Power or Weapon with the Force (X) Special Rule that targets a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of every Willpower Check made to use it.

rules.name: Wide-Band Command
rules.summary: A mnemonic data-hub that stretches the commander's control over distant automata.
rules.text: For the purposes of the Cold-Link Command Special Rule, a Model with this Special Rule counts as a commander within 24" of the Unit instead of within 12".

rules.name: Rally the Covenant
rules.summary: The cog-banner rises, and the thralls remember their purpose.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 6" of an Objective Marker, it automatically passes any Panic Check it is required to make.

rules.name: Strategos Lock
rules.summary: A war-engram slaved to the Praetorian's targeting.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls.

rules.name: Gyro-Lock
rules.summary: Stabiliser pylons keep the guns steady at speed.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule ignores any penalty to its Hit Tests, and any restriction on the Weapons it may use, that applies because it moved earlier in the same Battle Turn.

rules.name: War-Chant
rules.summary: Binharic psalms roared in time with the pistons shake the enemy's resolve.
rules.text: All enemy Models within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic.

rules.name: Reflex Subroutine
rules.summary: A parallel logic engine shortens the response cycle.
rules.text: Once per battle, a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule may declare one Reaction without spending any points of its Controlling Player's Reaction Allotment.

rites.name: The Logic Maniples
rites.flavor: Cold arithmetic does not break, and does not ask why.

modifiers.text: The Logic Maniples: Line (1), Cold Calculus.

modifiers.condition: when shooting at a unit another Cold Calculus unit has already fired at this phase

require.note: Bring at least two Castellax Maniples.
A Magos or Archmagos runs the maniples.

rites.text: Cold arithmetic does not break, and does not ask why.
benefits: Castellax Battle and Destructor Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Cold Calculus: +1 Ballistic Skill against an enemy Unit another Cold Calculus Unit has already shot at in the same Phase.
limitations: A Magos or Archmagos and at least two Castellax Maniples are required.
No Tech-Thrall Covenants, Myrmidon Hosts or Ursarax Cohorts.

rites.name: Ordo Reductor Siege Park
rites.flavor: Wall, tower and bunker are only data waiting to be subtracted.

modifiers.text: Ordo Reductor Siege Park: Subtractive Fire.

require.note: Bring at least two siege units.

rites.text: Wall, tower and bunker are only data waiting to be subtracted.
benefits: Karacnos Assault Tanks and Thanatar Siege Maniples may fill Troops slots.
Karacnos, Krios, Krios Venator, Thanatar and Ordinatus units gain Subtractive Fire: their Shooting Attacks ignore the target's Cover, Fortification Saves and Shrouded (X).
limitations: At least two Karacnos, Krios Venator or Thanatar units are required.
No Recon, no Fast Attack, and no Myrmidon Hosts or Ursarax Cohorts.
Table-top: units with Subtractive Fire may not be held in Reserves.

rites.name: The Myrmidax Cult-Host
rites.flavor: The cult remembers flesh, and has decided it was a mistake worth repeating.

modifiers.text: The Myrmidax Cult-Host: Line (1), Feel No Pain (6+), Cult Fervour.

require.note: Bring at least two Myrmidon Hosts.

rites.text: The cult remembers flesh, and has decided it was a mistake worth repeating.
benefits: Myrmidon Secutor and Destructor Hosts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Feel No Pain (6+).
They gain Cult Fervour: +2 Cool on Cool Checks, and once per battle a host at half strength or less adds 1 to Attacks for a Battle Turn.
limitations: At least two Myrmidon Hosts are required.

rites.name: The Thallax Vigil
rites.flavor: A magos with a dozen Thallax at her back has no need of an escort of friends.

modifiers.text: The Thallax Vigil: Line (1), Fear (1), Vigil Protocol.

require.note: Bring at least two Thallax Cohorts.

rites.text: A magos with a dozen Thallax at her back has no need of an escort of friends.
benefits: Thallax Cohorts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Fear (1).
They gain Vigil Protocol: a free 6" Set-up Move before the first Battle Turn (ending more than 9" from the enemy), and a Magos, Archmagos or Tech-Priest within 3" adds 1 to Cool.
limitations: At least two Thallax Cohorts are required.
No Tech-Priests, Tech-Thrall Covenants or Ursarax Cohorts.

rites.name: The Thrall Press
rites.flavor: The forge-world's billions are an engine too, and can be fed to the war.

modifiers.text: The Thrall Press: Line (1), Endless Tithe.

require.note: Bring at least two Tech-Thrall Covenants.

rites.text: The forge-world's billions are an engine too, and can be fed to the war.
benefits: Tech-Thrall Covenants (both kinds) may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Endless Tithe: once per battle, the first Covenant destroyed returns from Reserves with Outflank at half its starting Models.
limitations: At least two Tech-Thrall Covenants are required.
No Elites, Heavy Assault or Lord of War units.

armyRules.name: Cold-Link Command
armyRules.flavor: Automata think only as far as their master's signal reaches.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule within 12" of a friendly Magos, Archmagos or Arcuitor adds 1 to the Ballistic Skill Characteristic of all its Models.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule that is not within 12" of a friendly Magos, Archmagos or Arcuitor subtracts 1 from the Initiative Characteristic of all its Models.
armyRules.condition: within 12" of a friendly Magos, Archmagos or Arcuitor

armyRules.name: Cold Logic
armyRules.flavor: The Thallax and the Myrmidax have been purged of fear and doubt.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule automatically passes any Cool Check made for Pinning.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot declare Advanced Reactions.

armyRules.name: Overclocked Engines
armyRules.flavor: Forge-priests run their war machines past the safe limits.
benefits: A Vehicle with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Movement Characteristic.
drawbacks: After a Vehicle with this Special Rule Rushes, the Controlling Player rolls a Dice. On a 1 the Vehicle loses one Hull Point.
